items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 10 at 2:21AM AKST until November 10 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 35 mph with gusts up to 80 mph.

* WHERE...Cordova.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong winds will continue through mid-morning
Tuesday before quickly diminishing. Gusts to 80 mph are expected in
town, especially between 2 AM and 6 AM this morning, with gusts up
to 60 mph at the airport.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.
